senses.gloss: m. (טְרַף) document conferring the right of seizure of a debtor’s property sold after the loan, v. אַדְרַכְתָּא.
units: B. Bath. 169ᵃ כל ט׳ וכ׳ a tirpa which fails to contain the words, ‘We have torn the note of indebtedness’ &c.
B. Kam. 9ᵃ אחוי טִירְפָּךְ וכ׳ show thy t., and I shall pay thee.
